description: FlowSeer repository policy and edit feedback.

hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/tools/scripts/run.py" ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FlowSeer hook worktree-guard cannot run from $PWD: repository root ${root:-unresolved}, git $(command -v git || echo not on PATH), uv $(command -v uv || echo not on PATH)" >&2; exit 1; }; exec uv run "$root/tools/scripts/run.py" hooks worktree-guard
